information: The competition will be held in the Blass Gymnasium. The cost of registration is a flat fee of $22.97. $1 of your registration fee will go to CubingUSA and $1 will go towards funding SoCal cubing expenses. We will **not be taking registration at the door.** See the tabs for more details.
